mostWorthwhile.text: The ending's image of a creature learning an unheard song was a fitting expression of a world continuing independently.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter had no gameplay decisions, so there was no action to assess as repetitive or confusing.

surprise.text: The final chapter was an epilogue rather than another combination puzzle.

arbitrary.text: There were no actions in the final chapter to judge as arbitrary.

continue.text: Probably not immediately: the ending provides a natural stopping point, and this chapter offered no gameplay to make me curious about another.
